description: This file defines a React component `RecommendationGrid` that fetches and displays role recommendations based on filters and user persona. It includes internal functions for string normalization, filter matching, salary parsing, and rendering logic with hooks for data fetching and state management.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy or invalid entries.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary information from a role object to determine minimum and maximum salary in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object, trying multiple possible property names.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role object matches specified filter criteria including industry, skills, salary, and title.
